ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, straight lines AB and CD intersect at point O. If $\angle 1 + \angle 2 = 100^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle 1+\angle 2=100^\circ$ and $\angle 1=\angle 2$, \\
it follows that $\angle 1=\angle 2=50^\circ$. \\
Since $\angle 1+\angle BOC=180^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BOC=\boxed{130^\circ}$.
